final: WITH cnt AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM cnt WHERE c IS NOT NULL), sh AS (SELECT cnt.account_id, cnt.c, 1.0*cnt.c/tot.t AS s FROM cnt JOIN tot ON tot.t IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(s) AS a FROM sh WHERE s IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT sh.c, sh.s, sh.s - av.a AS d FROM sh JOIN av ON av.a IS NOT NULL WHERE sh.s > av.a) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_orders, AVG(s) AS avg_share, AVG(d) AS avg_diff FROM kept
